title: 个人财务与长期安排 · 100 句
description: 预算、储蓄、借款、保险、家庭费用、财务文件、风险辨识与长期安排；练习语言表达。

items.zh: 我的收入每个月都不同。
items.en: My income varies from month to month.
answers: My income varies from month to month.

items.zh: 固定支出先从预算中扣除。
items.en: Fixed expenses come out of the budget first.
answers: Fixed expenses come out of the budget first.

items.zh: 这笔收入不是每个月都有。
items.en: This income does not come in every month.
answers: This income does not come in every month.
This income doesn't come in every month.
items.notes: come in：收入到账；not every：并非每个。

items.zh: 我把日常和年度支出分开。
items.en: I separate everyday and annual expenses.
answers: I separate everyday and annual expenses.

items.zh: 税前金额和到手收入不同。
items.en: Gross pay differs from take-home pay.
answers: Gross pay differs from take-home pay.

items.zh: 这个月有一笔意外维修费。
items.en: There is an unexpected repair cost this month.
answers: There is an unexpected repair cost this month.

items.zh: 零碎消费加起来不少。
items.en: Small purchases add up.
answers: Small purchases add up.

items.zh: 我需要看完整个月的情况。
items.en: I need the picture for the whole month.
answers: I need the picture for the whole month.

items.zh: 这笔转账不是新的收入。
items.en: This transfer is not new income.
answers: This transfer is not new income.
This transfer isn't new income.

items.zh: 报销会晚于实际付款。
items.en: Reimbursement comes after the payment.
answers: Reimbursement comes after the payment.

items.zh: 我预留了不定期账单的费用。
items.en: I allowed for irregular bills.
answers: I allowed for irregular bills.

items.zh: 这项分类太宽泛。
items.en: This category is too broad.
answers: This category is too broad.

items.zh: 预算需要反映真实习惯。
items.en: A budget needs to reflect actual habits.
answers: A budget needs to reflect actual habits.

items.zh: 我不想把所有余额都花掉。
items.en: I do not want to spend the entire balance.
answers: I do not want to spend the entire balance.
I don't want to spend the entire balance.

items.zh: 这个计划没有留出缓冲。
items.en: This plan leaves no buffer.
answers: This plan leaves no buffer.

items.zh: 实际费用超出了预留金额。
items.en: Actual costs exceeded the allowance.
answers: Actual costs exceeded the allowance.

items.zh: 我会按需要调整分配。
items.en: I will adjust allocations as needed.
answers: I will adjust allocations as needed.

items.zh: 可用额度不等于可支配收入。
items.en: Available credit is not disposable income.
answers: Available credit is not disposable income.
Available credit isn't disposable income.

items.zh: 我需要知道哪项费用可以暂停。
items.en: I need to identify expenses I can pause.
answers: I need to identify expenses I can pause.

items.zh: 记录太复杂时很难坚持。
items.en: Complicated record-keeping is hard to maintain.
answers: Complicated record-keeping is hard to maintain.

items.zh: 我把这笔钱留给明确的用途。
items.en: I set this money aside for a defined purpose.
answers: I set this money aside for a defined purpose.

items.zh: 取用资金需要提前通知吗？
items.en: Is advance notice required to access the funds?
answers: Is advance notice required to access the funds?

items.zh: 利息是按日计算的吗？
items.en: Is interest calculated daily?
answers: Is interest calculated daily?

items.zh: 账户有提款次数限制。
items.en: The account limits the number of withdrawals.
answers: The account limits the number of withdrawals.

items.zh: 临时优惠结束后利率会变化。
items.en: The rate changes when the promotion ends.
answers: The rate changes when the promotion ends.

items.zh: 我需要区分存款与投资。
items.en: I need to distinguish deposits from investments.
answers: I need to distinguish deposits from investments.

items.zh: 这笔钱短期内可能要用。
items.en: I may need this money soon.
answers: I may need this money soon.

items.zh: 储蓄目标应该有时间范围。
items.en: A savings goal should have a timeframe.
answers: A savings goal should have a timeframe.

items.zh: 我不想为提款支付额外费用。
items.en: I do not want extra withdrawal charges.
answers: I do not want extra withdrawal charges.
I don't want extra withdrawal charges.

items.zh: 能否设置自动定期转入？
items.en: Can regular automatic deposits be arranged?
answers: Can regular automatic deposits be arranged?

items.zh: 每月还款包括本金和利息。
items.en: Monthly repayments include principal and interest.
answers: Monthly repayments include principal and interest.

items.zh: 最低还款额不等于全部欠款。
items.en: The minimum payment is not the full debt.
answers: The minimum payment is not the full debt.
The minimum payment isn't the full debt.

items.zh: 这笔贷款是否需要抵押？
items.en: Does this loan require collateral?
answers: Does this loan require collateral?

items.zh: 担保人的责任有哪些？
items.en: What obligations does the guarantor have?
answers: What obligations does the guarantor have?

items.zh: 延长还款期可能增加总费用。
items.en: A longer repayment period may increase total costs.
answers: A longer repayment period may increase total costs.

items.zh: 我需要书面的费用说明。
items.en: I need the charges explained in writing.
answers: I need the charges explained in writing.

items.zh: 这个报价使用浮动利率。
items.en: This quotation uses a variable rate.
answers: This quotation uses a variable rate.

items.zh: 优惠期之后会发生什么？
items.en: What happens after the introductory period?
answers: What happens after the introductory period?

items.zh: 逾期付款会如何记录？
items.en: How are late payments recorded?
answers: How are late payments recorded?
items.notes: late payment：逾期付款；询问记录方式。

items.zh: 我想在签字前理解所有义务。
items.en: I want to understand every obligation before signing.
answers: I want to understand every obligation before signing.

items.zh: 这份保障有哪些除外责任？
items.en: What exclusions apply to this cover?
answers: What exclusions apply to this cover?

items.zh: 自付额是多少？
items.en: What is the excess?
answers: What is the excess?

items.zh: 续保价格是否已经确定？
items.en: Has the renewal price been confirmed?
answers: Has the renewal price been confirmed?

items.zh: 理赔需要哪些证据？
items.en: What evidence is needed for a claim?
answers: What evidence is needed for a claim?

items.zh: 保障是否包括个人物品？
items.en: Does the cover include personal belongings?
answers: Does the cover include personal belongings?

items.zh: 这项损失发生在保单生效前。
items.en: The loss occurred before the policy began.
answers: The loss occurred before the policy began.

items.zh: 我需要申报情况变化吗？
items.en: Do I need to disclose a change in circumstances?
answers: Do I need to disclose a change in circumstances?

items.zh: 这份报价包括所有家庭成员吗？
items.en: Does the quote include every household member?
answers: Does the quote include every household member?

items.zh: 保障金额与赔付限额不同吗？
items.en: Does the insured amount differ from the payout limit?
answers: Does the insured amount differ from the payout limit?

items.zh: 我想知道取消保单的条件。
items.en: I want the conditions for cancelling the policy.
answers: I want the conditions for cancelling the policy.

items.zh: 与月付相比，年付能便宜多少？
items.en: How much cheaper is annual billing than monthly payment?
answers: How much cheaper is annual billing than monthly payment?
items.notes: how much cheaper ... than：相比便宜多少。

items.zh: 合同到期会自动续约。
items.en: The contract renews automatically at expiry.
answers: The contract renews automatically at expiry.

items.zh: 取消需要提前几天通知？
items.en: How many days' notice is needed to cancel?
answers: How many days' notice is needed to cancel?

items.zh: 停止使用不代表停止收费。
items.en: Stopping use does not stop charges.
answers: Stopping use does not stop charges.
Stopping use doesn't stop charges.

items.zh: 这个套餐的基础价格不含设备。
items.en: The base price excludes equipment.
answers: The base price excludes equipment.

items.zh: 我需要保留取消确认。
items.en: I need to keep the cancellation confirmation.
answers: I need to keep the cancellation confirmation.

items.zh: 账单周期与自然月不同。
items.en: The billing cycle differs from a calendar month.
answers: The billing cycle differs from a calendar month.

items.zh: 升级套餐会重新开始合同期吗？
items.en: Does an upgrade restart the contract term?
answers: Does an upgrade restart the contract term?

items.zh: 这项服务有提前终止费。
items.en: This service has an early termination fee.
answers: This service has an early termination fee.

items.zh: 降级后哪些功能会失去？
items.en: Which features disappear after a downgrade?
answers: Which features disappear after a downgrade?

items.zh: 共用支出需要双方都看得懂。
items.en: Shared expenses need to be understandable to both people.
answers: Shared expenses need to be understandable to both people.

items.zh: 我们应先约定分摊方式。
items.en: We should agree on cost sharing first.
answers: We should agree on cost sharing first.

items.zh: 一次性购买不能代表每月开销。
items.en: A one-off purchase is not a monthly expense.
answers: A one-off purchase is not a monthly expense.
A one-off purchase isn't a monthly expense.

items.zh: 孩子长大后费用结构变了。
items.en: Costs changed as the children grew.
answers: Costs changed as the children grew.

items.zh: 这笔支出用于必要的维修。
items.en: This expense covers essential repairs.
answers: This expense covers essential repairs.
items.notes: cover：支付；expense 与维修行为本身区分。

items.zh: 我们把搬家费用单独计算。
items.en: We calculate moving costs separately.
answers: We calculate moving costs separately.

items.zh: 租金不是居住的唯一成本。
items.en: Rent is not the only housing cost.
answers: Rent is not the only housing cost.
Rent isn't the only housing cost.

items.zh: 我想比较不同地点的通勤与住房总费用。
items.en: I want to compare the combined costs of commuting and housing in different locations.
answers: I want to compare the combined costs of commuting and housing in different locations.
items.notes: combined costs：合计费用；compare 明确比较任务。

items.zh: 费用分担不一定按人数平均。
items.en: Cost sharing need not be equal per person.
answers: Cost sharing need not be equal per person.
Cost sharing needn't be equal per person.

items.zh: 大额购买最好事先沟通。
items.en: Large purchases deserve advance discussion.
answers: Large purchases deserve advance discussion.

items.zh: 这张发票缺少付款日期。
items.en: This invoice lacks a payment date.
answers: This invoice lacks a payment date.

items.zh: 收据上的金额与记录一致。
items.en: The receipt amount matches the record.
answers: The receipt amount matches the record.

items.zh: 有些报销申请即使已提供扫描件，也仍要求提交原始收据。
items.en: Some expense claims require original receipts even when scans have been supplied.
answers: Some expense claims require original receipts even when scans have been supplied.
items.notes: even when 表示让步；expense claim：报销申请。

items.zh: 扫描件上的数字看不清。
items.en: The figures on the scan are illegible.
answers: The figures on the scan are illegible.

items.zh: 这个文件属于上一财年。
items.en: This document belongs to the previous financial year.
answers: This document belongs to the previous financial year.

items.zh: 费用说明应列出币种。
items.en: The expense record should state the currency.
answers: The expense record should state the currency.

items.zh: 我想标明这笔钱的用途。
items.en: I want to label the purpose of this payment.
answers: I want to label the purpose of this payment.

items.zh: 重复记录会夸大支出。
items.en: Duplicate entries overstate spending.
answers: Duplicate entries overstate spending.

items.zh: 这份汇总还没有核对。
items.en: This summary has not been reconciled.
answers: This summary has not been reconciled.
This summary hasn't been reconciled.

items.zh: 找不到凭证的项目先单独标记。
items.en: Flag entries without supporting documents separately.
answers: Flag entries without supporting documents separately.

items.zh: 宣传中的收益并不保证实现。
items.en: Advertised returns are not guaranteed.
answers: Advertised returns are not guaranteed.
Advertised returns aren't guaranteed.

items.zh: 过去表现不能确定未来结果。
items.en: Past performance cannot determine future outcomes.
answers: Past performance cannot determine future outcomes.
Past performance can't determine future outcomes.

items.zh: 我需要了解可能损失的最高金额。
items.en: I need to understand the maximum amount I could lose.
answers: I need to understand the maximum amount I could lose.
items.notes: maximum amount：最高金额；could 保留可能性。

items.zh: 资金被锁定多久？
items.en: How long are the funds locked in?
answers: How long are the funds locked in?

items.zh: 这项费用会侵蚀净收益。
items.en: This charge reduces the net return.
answers: This charge reduces the net return.

items.zh: 我不理解的产品需要更多解释。
items.en: An unfamiliar product needs further explanation.
answers: An unfamiliar product needs further explanation.

items.zh: 卖方可能获得销售佣金。
items.en: The seller may receive a commission.
answers: The seller may receive a commission.

items.zh: 高收益宣传应说明相应风险。
items.en: High-return claims should explain the associated risks.
answers: High-return claims should explain the associated risks.

items.zh: 我不想仅仅因为优惠即将结束就作出决定。
items.en: I do not want to make a decision just because the offer is about to expire.
answers: I do not want to make a decision just because the offer is about to expire.
I don't want to make a decision just because the offer is about to expire.
items.notes: just because 说明不希望受期限施压的原因。

items.zh: 比较必须使用相同的时间范围。
items.en: Comparisons need the same time horizon.
answers: Comparisons need the same time horizon.

items.zh: 今天的预算也要考虑未来义务。
items.en: Today's budget needs to consider future obligations.
answers: Today's budget needs to consider future obligations.

items.zh: 生活变化后目标可能需要调整。
items.en: Goals may need revision after life changes.
answers: Goals may need revision after life changes.

items.zh: 我想定期检查自己的安排。
items.en: I want to review my arrangements periodically.
answers: I want to review my arrangements periodically.

items.zh: 计划不能只依赖最乐观的情况。
items.en: A plan cannot rely solely on optimism.
answers: A plan cannot rely solely on optimism.
A plan can't rely solely on optimism.

items.zh: 家庭成员需要知道文件在哪里。
items.en: Family members need to know where documents are kept.
answers: Family members need to know where documents are kept.

items.zh: 设定新的储蓄目标之前，我需要计入已经承诺支付的款项。
items.en: Before setting a new savings target, I need to allow for payments I have already promised.
answers: Before setting a new savings target, I need to allow for payments I have already promised.
items.notes: allow for：计入；区分可调整目标和已承诺款项。

items.zh: 物价上涨会改变购买能力。
items.en: Rising prices change purchasing power.
answers: Rising prices change purchasing power.

items.zh: 退休开销可能与现在不同。
items.en: Retirement expenses may differ from current spending.
answers: Retirement expenses may differ from current spending.

items.zh: 这个目标需要分阶段实现。
items.en: This goal needs to be achieved in stages.
answers: This goal needs to be achieved in stages.

items.zh: 定期回顾比完全不调整更有用。
items.en: Regular review is better than leaving everything unchanged.
answers: Regular review is better than leaving everything unchanged.
